cases.proves_bugs: BUG-672 message half only (the sentence about the skipped cover text); the copy behaviour half is R33
cases.title: COPY of a pit with 25TEXT locked: the reply names layer 25TEXT and says what to do, and does not claim the copy has no label
cases.expected: With 25TEXT locked, COPY of pit P3 by 0,-5000 prints "1 pit copied and numbered as new.", adds one pit block and one PIT LABEL block reading a number that is not P3 and no "CL" text, and the CE line about the skipped text names layer 25TEXT and says "Undo (U), unlock layer 25TEXT, then copy again." It must NOT say "no label", because a label was drawn. One U takes the copy back. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: It needs AutoCAD's real layer lock and the real COPY clean-up.
not_automated: The wording the desk wants instead of "no label or cover text" is not recorded; the case only rejects the false claim and pins the layer name and the recovery sentence. The label appearance is a Codex look.

cases.title: Plain COPY of pit P3 (no Settings change): the copy gets its own number and the Check levels sentence, P3 keeps its label, and one U brings back the same objects
cases.expected: COPY of pit P3 (handle 109D56) by 0,-5000 prints "1 pit copied and numbered as new. Check levels: they came across from the originals (the Inspector shows which ones to confirm).", adds one pit block and one PIT LABEL reading a P number that is not P3, the original label 109E08 still reads P3 before, after the COPY and after the U, and one U brings the drawing back to 1034 objects with the same handles in every one of its three chunks. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The copy clean-up runs when AutoCAD ends the native COPY on the live drawing.
not_automated: DERIVED (29 Oct 2026 fix-up, Opus B6 review item 5): the copy reading exactly P8 is taken from the first free number on this test drawing (the other pit numbers on DRV1_B1 are P1 to P7, P9 and P10 and C1, so P8 is the one gap; a brand-new pit on this drawing also reads P8 in case N05), not from a card line that guarantees P8. The number is not compared against a live read of every pit label. The copy's levels (the Check levels content) and the Pit Schedule cells are not read. ROTATE Copy, SCALE Copy and grip Ctrl-drag are R34, R34s, R34so and R34sn. The handle comparison is fixture-specific (1034 objects); a general sorted-set reader would be better.
